headline: Supermarkets Accumulate 110 Million in Extra Energy Costs Since the Middle East War Began
summary: Spanish supermarkets have accumulated 110 million euros in extra energy costs since the Middle East war began. The figure reflects the cost pressure on grocery retailers from higher energy prices.
why: Supermarkets run energy-intensive refrigeration and logistics, so energy price shocks feed directly into retail margins and food prices.
